segments.text: Nay contrarily, vnlesse we be first perswaded of Gods loue towards vs, we neuer loue him. For we loue him, because he loued vs first. 1. Ioh. 4.19. Againe, it is impossible that Gods enemie should loue him: but he which is not as yet iustified, or reconciled to God, he is Gods enemie. Rom. 5.9,10. Neither is any man before the act of iustification, made of Gods enemie his friend.
